name: fh-research-kit

metadata.description: Family history research skills for Claude: research logs, ancestor stories and Memories uploads for people who use the FamilySearch website.

plugins.name: fh-research-sources
plugins.description: Research one ancestor through Claude in Chrome: FamilySearch relationship check, attached sources, and searches of the record sites the user picks. Saves the person's data JSON. Use for "research John Smith ABCD-123" or "research this ancestor".

plugins.name: fh-build-log
plugins.description: Build or rebuild an ancestor's research log (Word, PDF, Markdown) from their saved data JSON in Claude Code, update the tracker and supersede older versions. Use for "build the log".

plugins.name: fh-write-story
plugins.description: Write an ancestor's life story from their data JSON, build it with story.py and make the People in this story list. Use only after the user says yes to the story.

plugins.name: rerun-ancestor-log
plugins.description: Re-check one ancestor's FamilySearch record after the user fixes the tree, then update their log, story, People list and tracker. Use for "fixed, run again", "rerun", "check and update".

plugins.name: upload-story-memory
plugins.description: Upload a new story PDF to FamilySearch Memories and tag everyone with a PID in its People list. Use for "upload the story", "add the story to FamilySearch", "post the story as a memory".

plugins.name: replace-story-memory
plugins.description: Replace a story that is already a FamilySearch Memory with its new PDF, keeping the old tags plus anyone new. Use for "replace the story", "update the story memory", "upload the new story".

plugins.name: fh-family-evaluation
plugins.description: Check a FamilySearch couple and all their children for wrong children, duplicates, grandchildren or mixed families, using sources, census and the GRO index, and build a Family Evaluation. Use for "evaluate this family".

description: Family history research skills for Claude: research logs, ancestor stories and Memories uploads for people who use the FamilySearch website.
